**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

**What I found:** Section 9 "Warranties" (p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate-existence/authority/enforceability/no-conflict representations plus a Globix Agreement acknowledgement. I checked HDI's Responsibilities (§1, p0004–p0014), Site Management (§5, p0030–p0035), and searched for "AS IS"/merchantability/disclaimer language — there is:

- No workmanlike-performance standard for HDI's development, hosting, maintenance or management services
- No conformance warranty or warranty period for the Site
- No warranty remedy (re-performance, repair, replacement, refund)
- No compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty from HDI

The only performance protection is the §1.6 right to terminate if the Site isn't live within 70 days — a termination trigger, not a conformance warranty. This fails even the fallback position (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies).

**Redline (validated ok:true):** New Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 with the preferred position — workmanlike services, 90-day conformance to agreed specifications keyed to the §5.2 written acceptance mechanic, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and a re-perform/repair/refund remedy at HDI's option.

One point worth noting for negotiation: the agreement contains no "AS IS" or implied-warranty disclaimer, so no carve-out was needed and the insert should be relatively uncontroversial. Also flagging that §10.7 survival covers Section 9, so the new warranty will survive for two years post-termination — favourable to us, but HDI may push to carve the new subsection out of that survival period.
